name: Strata
description: Run supported Qwen models on Windows or Linux PCs with NVIDIA or AMD GPUs, with a local UI and model APIs.
compatibility: OpenAI-compatible API, Anthropic Messages, OpenAI Responses, and a setup MCP server.
limitations: The standard setup requires a supported GPU with at least 12 GB VRAM, at least 32 GB RAM, and about 80 GB free disk.
Model support is specific; experimental hardware paths and AMD vision support have additional limits.

sources.note: Upstream description, setup, and documented requirements.
